# Data quality scorecard

*Generated by `scripts/generate/scorecard.py` from the last run (`target/run_results.json`). Don't edit it: run the build, then the script. CI fails if it's out of date.*

Every test that ran, by the domain of the data it checks and its quality dimension: how many passed, of how many. A warning passed, over a limit its owner agreed to watch; a failure stops the build, and the tests on what's built from it don't run. Validity says a value is allowed, by its rule; accuracy says it's true, against a reference outside the data, named below. Each test's owner and dimension are in its `meta` (docs/conventions.md, *Governance*).

## What each accuracy test checks against

A test measures accuracy only against a reference outside the data, such as a record kept apart from the data's source; against a copy of the same source, it measures consistency. Each names its reference in its `meta` (docs/conventions.md, *Which reference*).

| Domain | Test | Reference | Owner |
|---|---|---|---|
| `finance` | `reconcile_finance_with_tuition_report` | Finance's own tuition report | Finance |
| `planning` | `reconcile_planning_with_census_report` | the census team's published report | Planning |
| `student` | `awards_match_the_boards` | the exam boards' approved lists | Mei Tanaka, registrar's office |
| `student` | `graduation_list_accents_all_gone` | **none named** | Mei Tanaka, registrar's office |
| `student` | `graduation_list_family_name_at_30` | **none named** | Mei Tanaka, registrar's office |
| `student` | `graduation_list_family_name_in_capitals` | **none named** | Mei Tanaka, registrar's office |
| `student` | `old_form_names_not_yet_confirmed` | the graduate | Mei Tanaka, registrar's office |
| `student` | `printers_file_has_the_names_graduates_gave` | The graduate, through their last answer in the portal | Mei Tanaka, registrar's office |

## Hand-check hours

The hidden work, counted: the hours the graduations team spent checking the graduation list's names by hand before each round's list went to the printer, from its calendar (`seeds/reference/graduations/hand_check_rounds.csv`). Beside the tests, so everyone can watch them fall as names are put right where they're born.

| Year | Rounds | Names checked by hand | Hours |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2025–26 | 3 | 3,807 of 3,807 | 320 |
| 2026–27 | 1 | 78 of 2,140 | 26 |
